          Your G99 application.Prepared. Submitted. Followed through.
          Before your installation operates in parallel with the grid, the required connection permission needs to be in place. Aesir handles the G99 Form A1-2 application process with the appropriate DNO or IDNO across Great Britain.
          01Validate the installation’s eligibility02Prepare the form, diagram and evidence03Submit to the right network operator04Follow up through the decision and commissioning notification
          Installers keep their own job and accreditation. Property owners can separately discuss installation with us. Our fee covers the application service; it does not buy a solar installation or guarantee network approval.
        
        
          G99 FORM A1-2 APPLICATION SERVICE
          £300total
          £250 fee + £50 VATOne payment per application.
          Start your application ↗
          Check eligibility ↗
          Talk to us first ↗
          Not sure Form A1-2 fits your installation? Discuss suitability with us before paying.
        
      
      How light becomes electrical energy
        Absorb and collect. Silicon absorbs light and transfers its energy to charge carriers. The cell’s structure enables charge separation and current extraction through metal contacts. The photon does not become an electron.
        Direct current to alternating current. Module interconnections and a connected DC circuit carry electrical energy from the illuminated array to an inverter, which converts DC to AC.
        The blue moving bands illustrate energy flow, not individual electrons or a measured speed. The inverter graph shows voltage changing over time; its curve is not the shape of a cable. Generation requires continuing illumination and a connected circuit.
        The generic module, enlarged cell layers and inverter are original educational illustrations. They do not identify a manufacturer, complete string design, equipment rating or live output. Learn more from the DOE cell explanation and inverter explanation.
